questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Jeg ville kun til Paris.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Relativt nemt.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Jeg skulle skifte fag, hvilket gik rigtig nemt. Jeg var dog også godt forberedt.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Det gik okay nemt, men jeg havde også givet mig selv et ret højt budget. Jeg endte med at finde et studio i det 11. arrondissement til omkring 1100 euro.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Det var helt fint, men der er rigtig langt til Dauphine, så det skal man være forberedt på.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Man bliver sendt et link til registrering af kurser og så har man en uge til at vælge. Det gik nemt nok, bortset fra, at to af mine kurser til sidst blev aflyst, så jeg måtte gøre det forfra fysisk efter semesterstart.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Dere udvekslingskontor stod klar på e-mail og var rigtig behjælpelige.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: I første omgang ikke så succesful, men i anden omgang fik jeg alle, jeg bad om.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Lad være med at stresse. Det skal nok ordne sig.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: Both

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Niveauet var akademisk lavt. Jeg havde intet pensum, ingen akademiske opgaver, blev undervist i lige præcis nul teori. Mængden af lektier var til gengæld, ironisk nok, rimelig heftig.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Den var meget anderledes. Der var intet pensum, så man kunne ikke læse op på noget, hvis man missede en undervisning. Undervisningen var ikke pensum-baseret og var for det meste rimelig uakademisk i mine øjne. Mest af alt er det en lærer foran en tavle, der taler derudad. Så skal man egentlig bare skrive så mange noter som muligt, fordi ellers er det bare ærgerligt.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer: Jeg havde kun 15 ECTS: Islam and the State (6 ECTS), History of Economic Thought (6 ECTS), Sociology of Armed Conflict (3 ECTS).

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Jeg kan ikke anbefale Dauphine i det hele taget, men ovenstående fag var fine nok. Aurélie Daher, som underviser i to af fagene, er en lidt speciel underviser, men også enormt interessant og ekspert på hendes områder.

What unexpected costs did you encounter? *
questions.answer: Ingen. Men jeg var stadig overrasket over, hvor hurtigt beløbene løber op.

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: Husleje. Jeg havde håbet at finde noget billigere, men det var ikke en mulighed, da jeg gerne ville bo alene i bestemte områder.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Brugte ingen.

questions.question: What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Der var mange forskellige, men jeg brugte dem ikke.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Der var meget sport.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Jeg tog en weekendtur til Lyon (selv-arrangeret), hvilket virkelig kan anbefales! Det er en vildt fed by.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Nemt nok.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Mest ift. studiet. Læring på Dauphine er 100% udenadslære. Eksaminerne er stedprøver uden hjælpemidler og skal skrives i hånden. Det var en kæmpe udfordring for mig personligt, da det ligger meget langt fra KU.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Paris har fantastisk kultur og jeg satte pris på det hele.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Dauphine er ikke egnet til statskundskabsstuderende, og slet ikke på kandidatniveau, som jeg er. Udvalget af kurser er virkelig dårligt. Hvis muligt (det var det ikke for mig), så tag på Sciences Po.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Tilmeld dig det franskkursus som KU udbyder! Det var der jeg mødte de fleste af dem jeg endte med at ses med under opholdet.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Bare at være i byen og lære sproget.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Eksaminerne.

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
